Usage: astryx experimental icon [options] [command] [query...]

[experimental] Find an icon by meaning, or build an icon set from a library (guide: astryx docs cli/experimental/icon-sets)

Options:
  --list                             List the installed icon sets and do nothing else; a query is refused
  --set <name>                       Search one set, by name or <package>/<set>
  --limit <n>                        Max number of matches, a positive integer (default 10)
  --definitions                      Every Astryx icon definition, one line each: name, built in or not, description, words
  --all-icons                        With --set and no words: every icon of that set, one line each (id, words, definitions)
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  use <set>                          [experimental] Choose the project's icon set
  map [options] [definition] [icon]  [experimental] Register which icon of your set draws an icon definition
  add [options] [export]             [experimental] Register one icon you chose from a library in your icon set
  new-set [options] <name>           [experimental] Start an icon set in your integration package
  new-definition [options] <name>    [experimental] Add your icon set's own icon definition

Exit codes:
  0  success (including zero matches)
  1  no query and no --list, a query with --list, a --limit that is not a positive integer, or a set or icon that is not installed

Examples:
  # Find by meaning
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon delete
  # One icon and its variants
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon outline/trash
  # Installed sets
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon --list --json
  # Every icon of one set
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon --set outline --all-icons
  # One set, top 3
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon arrow --set outline --limit 3

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental-icon
